title: Restaurant Ordering
description: Practice ordering food, asking simple questions, and responding politely.
descriptionZh: 练习点餐、询问菜品和礼貌回应。

context.setting: A casual restaurant where the learner orders lunch.
context.learnerPurpose: Order food politely and ask simple questions about the menu.

goals.label: Ask a menu question
successCriteria: Asks about ingredients, price, or recommendations

constraints: Keep the exchange simple and practical.
Ask one menu-related question at a time.
